reviews.text: Very good treatment and everyone is very nice.

Hello again, we're delighted with the professionals at Urban Dog. They trained him and it's gone really well; now I can walk him around town with peace of mind. They also have a Terra de Gossos Hotel. He stayed there for a few days and they send me a video of my dog ​​(Yogi) every day. My dog ​​is the one in the photo.
Most importantly, they are trustworthy and very responsible. It's worth it!
A fantastic place for a doggy holiday!! My dog ​​had a blast!!

As a dog daycare, it's great; they're affectionate with the dogs. However, their training service is terrible. When you pay, they plan the training, but there's no follow-up or explanation of what they do during the training, much less afterward. It was useless; it was literally throwing money away. I had to find another center, where we were delighted with the results.
